5dc6ae04-d1df-4f1d-af2a-dacca1126c7b.JobDescriptionV2:
We are seeking a high-leverage, systems-driven GTM Engineer (Demand Generation) to own the top of the funnel for both of our motions: direct outbound to advertisers and partner recruitment outbound to PPC agencies for our referral program. One engine, two scored universes, two message tracks. This is the classic GTM performance high-velocity, "AI-First" performance channel role. You will serve as the architect and operator of our entire demand engine: the scored account universe, the outbound infrastructure, the audit funnel, and the reporting layer that ties every booked meeting back to the signal that sourced it.

Your superpower is turning externally observable signals into booked pipeline: you treat outbound as a data engineering problem first and a copywriting problem second. You don't just build outbound infrastructure; you build a compounding revenue system, one where every send, reply, and disqualification feeds back into sharper targeting, so the engine gets smarter and cheaper with every cycle while headcount stays flat.

What You'll Own

  • The scored account universe (built with our data contractor): advertiser tiers, and agencies by portfolio size and vertical
  • Cold outbound infrastructure end-to-end: domains, warmup, deliverability, sequencing, reply handling
  • AI-assisted personalization at scale; we are an AI-native company and expect LLMs used as infrastructure, not as a writing toy
  • Partner-recruitment sequences pitching our commission program to agencies (50% year one for Certified partners; the program sells itself when it reaches the right inbox)
  • Retargeting against the named account list; full-funnel reporting from signal to audit to trial to paid

You're a Fit If

  • You've personally built an outbound system that booked revenue-generating meetings and can show the numbers
  • You understand Google Ads and Meta Ads well enough to write credibly to the people who run them
  • Hands-on with Clay (or equivalent), Smartlead/Instantly/Apollo, enrichment APIs, webhooks
  • You can explain SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and warmup without Googling
  • You treat agencies as a second ICP with different psychology: heavily pitched, margin-sensitive, motivated by client retention and passive revenue

You're Not a Fit If

  • Your portfolio is brand campaigns, social calendars, or SEO articles
  • You measure success in sends and opens rather than meetings and revenue
  • You need a team around you; this role builds the foundation solo

Required Skills & Experience

  1. 3-6+ Years in Outbound/Growth Systems: Proven experience building and operating cold outbound engines that booked revenue-generating meetings in a B2B SaaS or high-velocity agency environment. You can show the numbers: list size, reply rate, meeting rate, pipeline attributed.
  2. Signal-Based Targeting: Concrete experience constructing scored account universes from external signals (spend intelligence, ad libraries, technographics, job postings) rather than buying static lists. You treat targeting as a data problem, not a database purchase.
  3. Deliverability Ownership: You have personally owned sending infrastructure end-to-end: domain architecture, warmup, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, inbox placement monitoring, and recovery from deliverability incidents. No handing this off.
  4. AI-Native Execution: LLMs are infrastructure in your workflow, not a drafting toy. You have built personalization, enrichment, or reply-handling systems in which a model runs within the pipeline under guardrails you designed.
  5. Full-Funnel Accountability: You measure yourself on booked meetings, show rates, and downstream conversion quality, never on sends and opens. Track record of killing your own campaigns when the data said so.
  6. Dual-Audience Range: Ability to write credibly to two very different buyers: performance marketers who will smell a generic sequence instantly, and agency owners who are pitched daily and filter for vendors that make them look good.

Technical Proficiency

  • Paid Media Literacy: (Working Level) Enough Google Ads and Meta Ads fluency to speak the ICP's language: campaign types, CPCs, ROAS, invalid traffic. You will be writing to people who live in these platforms daily.
  • Sequencing & Sending Infrastructure: (Expert Level) Smartlead, Instantly, Apollo, or equivalent, including multi-domain setups, rotation, and reply routing.
  • Enrichment & Signal APIs: Working fluency with SEMrush/SpyFu, Meta Ad Library, technographic trackers (BuiltWith/Wappalyzer class), and people-data providers; comfort consuming REST APIs and webhooks directly.
  • HubSpot CRM Ecosystem: Strong proficiency in pipeline structures, custom properties, and attribution instrumentation so every meeting traces to its sourcing signal.
  • Automation Engineering: Strong execution knowledge of workflow automation (n8n, Make, Zapier, or native AI-agent integrations) connecting the stack without engineering support.

Logistics

  • Remote, async-first team culture.
  • Must have overlapping availability for live syncs between 7 AM and 2 PM EST.
  • Full-time, long-term leadership position.

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive salary - Compensation that reflects your expertise and contributions.
  • High-impact role – You’ll be leading product decisions in a company that values speed, innovation, and customer obsession.
  • Hands-on environment – We operate lean, so your contributions will be direct and meaningful.
  • Fast-growing industry – AdTech / MarTech is a quickly evolving space, making this an exciting space to be in.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic.

246dd96f-853c-400d-8a99-1453da04cfca.JobDescriptionV2:
About the Job

Our GTM thesis is defined: who we sell to, the motions we run, and the economics behind them. Your job is to turn that strategy into a measurable pipeline.

You will own the growth engine across outbound, paid acquisition, lifecycle, and partner/affiliate channels. You'll set channel priorities, establish pipeline targets, allocate resources, direct specialists, and run the reporting rhythm that tells leadership what is working and what isn't.

This is not a role focused on generating activity for activity's sake. You own business outcomes: qualified pipeline, acquisition efficiency, conversion, and ultimately whether our growth motions are producing revenue opportunities.

What You'll Own

GTM Engine Management

GTM engine management. Own outbound pipeline outcomes across advertisers and PPC agencies. Set pipeline targets, campaign priorities, audience strategy, message consistency, and accountability.

Partner & Affiliate Program Development

Develop the onboarding, enablement, and growth strategy for our agency partner and affiliate referral program. Your job is to build a repeatable system that can generate traffic, conversions, sales, and pipeline.

Lifecycle Marketing

Own nurture sequences, onboarding flows, campaign calendars, segmentation, and marketing automation in HubSpot. Ensure leads move through the funnel intentionally and that lifecycle workflows contribute measurably to lead-to-MQL and downstream conversion.

Reporting & Operating Rhythm

Own the growth scorecard. Run the weekly reporting rhythm across pipeline, paid acquisition, CAC, lifecycle, and partner performance.

Provide and maintain a clear view of:

  • Pipeline generated

  • Meetings booked

  • Pipeline-to-close rate

  • Blended CAC

  • CPL and CPA

  • Lead-to-MQL conversion

  • Partner/affiliate performance

  • Workflow completion and data hygiene

Your job is not to make the numbers look good. It's to make the numbers useful.

Required Experience

5+ years in B2B growth, demand generation, or performance marketing, including experience at a company under 100 people where you both developed strategy and helped execute it.

Owned pipeline, not just programs. You've been accountable for a pipeline or revenue-related number that Sales also cared about and you can explain what happened during a quarter when you missed it.

Outbound GTM experience. You understand modern B2B outbound strategy and can effectively direct technical specialists responsible for enrichment, scoring, deliverability and sequencing.

Paid media fluency. Basic working knowledge of Google and Meta Ads, including acquisition economics and downstream conversion measurement.

HubSpot fluency. Workflows, lifecycle stages, segmentation, attribution, automation, and reporting. You can build the dashboard, not just read it.

Directed specialists and contractors. You know how to establish outcomes, evaluate performance, and hold technical specialists accountable without pretending to be the functional expert in every discipline.

AI-leveraged operating. You use automation and LLM workflows to operate with significantly more leverage than traditional marketing teams.

Commercial reporting instinct. You surface bad numbers early, investigate why they happened, and are willing to kill your own initiatives when the economics don't work.

Ideal Candidate

  • Deep background in SaaS, AdTech, MarTech, PPC, or digital marketing products

  • Experience selling to advertisers, agencies, or performance marketers

  • Experience building or scaling outbound GTM motions

  • Experience developing partner or affiliate programs

  • Strong understanding of CAC, funnel economics, attribution, and pipeline forecasting

  • Comfortable operating in a lean environment where strategy and execution aren't separated by layers of management

If this sounds like you, we 100% need to talk, and we look forward to your application.


Note: Candidates must have significant working overlap and be actively available for the majority of our core hours (7AM to 3PM EST).

Role Overview

The Head of Sales & Customer Success owns the full commercial lifecycle — from first outbound touch to long-term retention — with a decisive bias toward new revenue generation. You are, first and foremost, a Hunter: you will personally run inbound demos, architect outbound systems, and coach a small team to close mid-market and enterprise deals with urgency. Secondarily, you are the Defender of the existing base: you oversee Customer Success and Support to protect NRR, neutralize churn, and drive expansion.

This is a player-coach seat. You manage a lean, multi-functional team (BDR, AE, Account Manager, Support) and are expected to be in the deal, not just above it.

Key Responsibilities

Outbound engine & pipeline architecture - Primary focus

  • Architect and own the "cold-to-closed" outbound system: sequence design, BDR workflow, SQL volume targets, and continuous A/B iteration.

  • Deploy AI-driven workflows for lead research, hyper-personalized outreach at scale, and meeting transcript analysis — eliminating low-leverage manual prospecting tasks for the BDR team.

  • Personally run high-stakes discovery calls and demos, demonstrating elite objection handling and value-based closing techniques to the team in real time.

  • Design and maintain the full sales playbook: outreach cadences, email templates, objection-handling wikis, and closing scripts that encode your best instincts into repeatable systems.

Inbound funnel mastery - Primary focus

  • Own end-to-end conversion for organic and paid inbound leads: speed-to-lead, qualification, demo scheduling, and close.

  • Maintain a demo show rate above 85% through automated AI-reminders and tight pre-demo qualification.

  • Identify and eliminate friction at every stage of the mid-to-bottom funnel to compress sales cycle length.

Sales team leadership & coaching Primary focus

  • Directly manage BDRs and AEs using an LMA (Leadership, Management, Accountability) framework in a remote-first, high-accountability culture.

  • Coach the team on discovery, demo delivery, advanced objection handling, and closing — turning reps into commercial operators, not order-takers.

  • Run structured forecast reviews and pipeline hygiene sessions; zero tolerance for "dark funnel" activity outside HubSpot.

HubSpot ownership & revenue forecasting

  • Architect the CRM deal stages to accurately reflect the buyer's journey for both inbound and outbound channels.

  • Maintain 100% data integrity for lead attribution, deal forecasting, and pipeline velocity — HubSpot is the single source of truth, no shadow systems.

  • Deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly revenue forecasts grounded in historical conversion rates and pipeline data.

Customer success & retention Supporting function

  • Oversee Account Managers and Support Specialists, transitioning the team from reactive ticket-handling to a proactive revenue-defense model.

  • Segment the customer portfolio by spend velocity, industry, and risk profile; deploy tiered engagement playbooks (white-glove for high-velocity agencies; automated touchpoints for SMBs).

  • Proactively identify at-risk accounts through usage signals and health metrics before cancellation requests surface — deploy "save" playbooks early.

  • Drive expansion and upsell revenue within the existing base to sustain NRR above 105%.

  • Ensure 100% of high-velocity and agency accounts receive a verified ROI report (money saved / CAC reduced) at regular intervals.

Mandatory requirements

  • 7+ years in senior Sales, CS, or Account Management roles within B2B SaaS — with clear ownership of New Business (CAC), Churn, and Expansion (NRR).

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience building and scaling outbound sales systems, including multi-channel sequence design and BDR management against aggressive SQL targets.

  • Proven track record as a direct closer: running live demos and navigating complex objections through to "Closed Won" on mid-market or enterprise deals.

  • Expert-level HubSpot proficiency: lifecycle management, automation, deal-stage architecture, and reporting.

  • Analytically self-sufficient: comfortable performing deep-dive analysis on traffic patterns, churn signals, and conversion bottlenecks without relying on a dedicated Data analyst.

  • Demonstrated AI implementation: architected and deployed autonomous agents or multi-step automations (LLM APIs, Make.com, custom GPTs) that eliminated at least 50% of manual overhead in a sales or support function.

  • Multi-functional remote leadership: proven success managing BDRs, AEs, and CSMs in a high-accountability, distributed environment.

Nice to have

  • Deep PPC / ad fraud domain knowledge: Google Ads (MCC), Meta, Bing, and sophisticated IVT pattern recognition.

  • Fluency in the language of Media Buyers and CMOs — selling "ROAS protection" and "budget efficiency," not just software features.

  • Experience selling or supporting "black box" autonomous tech where value must be consistently unpacked through data reporting.

  • Prior work within or for a performance marketing agency; familiarity with agency churn dynamics and "silent defense" client retention needs.

  • Advanced outbound intelligence stack experience: Apollo.io, Clay, Instantly.ai integrated into HubSpot for automated prospecting engines.

  • Advanced prompt engineering or custom GPT-building applied to specific CS or sales bottlenecks.

  • EOS familiarity: comfortable operating within the Integrator/Visionary dynamic, owning departmental Rocks, and leading Level 10 meetings.

f172ad9b-9b28-41b1-a7da-e7923dfb07f6.JobDescriptionV2:
About the Job
We’re hiring a hands-on Performance & Growth Manager.

This is not a traditional PPC role.

And it’s not a “set-and-maintain” role either.

You’ll operate at the intersection of:

  • Paid acquisition

  • Creative experimentation

  • CRO & funnel optimization

  • Growth strategy & lifecycle thinking

With real ownership over outcomes, not just execution.

You’ll be expected to:

  • Challenge what exists

  • Improve how growth is done

  • And take responsibility for what actually moves the needle

Using AI as a core efficiency lever — not as a replacement for thinking.

This role tends to work best for people who enjoy ownership, autonomy, and environments where things are still being built.

Key Responsibilities

Performance & Acquisition

  • Own paid acquisition across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels

  • Lead creative-first experimentation, not platform mechanics

  • Turn performance into clear, defensible conclusions: why it worked / why it didn’t

  • Iterate fast based on signal and measurable business impact

Creative & Learning Loops

  • Consistently identify angles, insights, and opportunities most people miss

  • Brief, review, and iterate on creatives with direct, actionable feedback

  • Push for speed, quality, and fast learning through disciplined execution

CRO & Funnel Optimization

  • Design and run CRO experiments across landing pages and funnels

  • Improve conversion rates in close collaboration with Marketing and Product

  • Translate traffic quality and user behavior into prioritized, concrete optimization actions

Email & Lifecycle

  • Own email marketing strategy and prioritization, in close collaboration with the CRM Lifecycle Specialist

  • Plan lifecycle initiatives across onboarding, trial nurturing, activation, and retention.

  • Execute email campaigns (one-off / broadcast) with correct segmentation and timing logic

  • Implement experimentation on email campaigns (A/B tests, splits on subject lines, copy, timing, or strategy)

  • Monitor and optimize email performance at an email-level metrics and business impact level

Growth Contribution

  • Actively contribute to growth initiatives where impact is highest.

  • Operate beyond channel silos, with clear alignment on priorities and expected impact

Mandatory Requirements

Core experience

To be successful in this role, you must have proven, hands-on experience with:

  • Running paid acquisition across platforms such as Google, Meta, and LinkedIn — with clear ownership over performance outcomes

  • Full-funnel thinking, including a strong understanding of conversion mechanics, trade-offs, and attribution logic

  • Practical CRO and experimentation experience (landing pages, UX, funnels), beyond surface-level tests

  • Hands-on experience with email marketing and lifecycle campaigns

AI & efficiency

(In 2026, this is simply part of the job)

AI is a baseline expectation, not a bonus.

You’re expected to:

  • Use AI daily to increase speed, output, and decision quality

  • Build lightweight workflows that remove manual or repetitive work

  • Maintain strong critical thinking — AI without iteration leads to generic output

  • Use AI to amplify thinking and judgment, not replace them

We use technology to move faster — so we can invest more time in clear thinking, creativity, and clarity.

This Role Won’t Be a Good Fit If

  • Your work is mostly focused on bid adjustments, audiences, or platform tuning

  • You rely heavily on predefined “best practices” without questioning them

  • You use AI to replace thinking instead of improving it

  • You prefer fixed scopes over contributing across growth initiatives

  • You’re uncomfortable with ownership or being accountable for outcomes

Qualifications & Skills

What we’re looking for

This role requires a combination of execution strength and independent thinking.

You should be comfortable with:

  • Being deeply hands-on, with direct ownership over execution and outcomes

  • Working through experiments, not static setups or predefined playbooks

  • Executing and iterating on lifecycle touchpoints (including email) as part of a broader growth system

  • Moving fast while maintaining quality

  • Clearly explaining why something worked or failed, not just what happened

  • Giving and receiving direct, honest feedback

  • Using AI to work faster while raising the quality bar

  • Bringing ideas and perspectives we’re not already using — and defending them with logic

How you think

  • You have a critical and creative mindset, not just the ability to execute instructions

  • You’re comfortable questioning assumptions — including your own

  • You can turn insights into action across channels and touchpoints, not just analysis or opinions

What Sets You Apart (Nice to Have)

These are clear signals of above-average impact and maturity:

  • Experience contributing to cross-functional growth initiatives beyond paid media, CRO and Email & Lifecycle

  • You’ve been part of strategic growth discussions where trade-offs were explicit, and can explain how performance insights shaped priorities, not just results

  • You can clearly connect performance signals to product, lifecycle, or positioning decisions — and are comfortable challenging assumptions when data and intuition diverge

Role Overview

This role is for a true go-getter who likes to move fast, own outcomes, and see their work turn directly into results. If high-volume outreach, tight follow-through, and clear scoreboards motivate you, you’ll feel right at home at ClickGuard.

The SDR drives a qualified pipeline through consistent cold calling to ICP accounts and rapid engagement with warm leads where Speed-to-Lead matters. Demo attendance is owned end to end, from T-24h and T-1h confirmations to no-show recovery. The role covers prospects across US East, US West, and EMEA time zones from a fixed 10:00–18:00 ET shift. Success is simple and visible: qualified demos booked, strong demo show rates, and fast Speed-to-Lead.

Key Responsibilities

Prospecting & Pipeline Generation

  • Make 70–90 cold calls/day to ICP accounts and book qualified demos for AEs.
  • Run multi-touch cadences (calls/SMS/email/LinkedIn) and personalize outreach.

Warm Leads & Speed-to-Lead

  • Call/SMS/email inbound and hand-raise leads during shift with median Speed-to-Lead ≤ 5 minutes; ensure ≥90% touched within 15 minutes.
  • Qualify for ICP and schedule demos promptly.

Demo Attendance & Recovery

  • Execute T-24h and T-1h confirmations (prospect local time).
  • Ensure calendar accuracy (timezone, attendees, link); reschedule no-shows within 7 days.

Global Coverage & Scheduling

  • Work daily blocks for EMEA late afternoon, US East prime, and US West morning/lunch.
  • Track DST changes; confirm bookings in the prospect’s local time.

Systems, Process & Hygiene

  • Operate 100% in HubSpot (tasks, sequences, notes) and place all calls via Aircall (dispositions/notes/VM drops).
  • Maintain clean data and honor opt-outs/compliance.

Collaboration & Reporting

  • Partner with AEs to draft clean handoff notes that include prospect context and pain points to reduce prep time and are all documented in our CRM/Playbook.
  • Update dashboards and report weekly on activity, conversion, and show-rate metrics.

Mandatory Requirements

  • 2+ years of outbound SDR/BDR experience selling subscription-based B2B SaaS products, including trial-to-paid or demo-led motions, hitting demo/opportunity quotas.
  • Hands-on with HubSpot (required) and Aircall (required).
  • Strong English communication skills (C1 or higher)
  • Comfortable with high-volume calling, multi-channel outreach (SMS/email), and global time-zone work.
  • Strong organizational discipline and CRM hygiene.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Proven cold-calling/objection-handling; talk time 90–120 min/day.
  • Speed-to-Lead mindset for warm leads; confirmation/no-show recovery playbook.
  • Sequencing and list management in HubSpot; accurate dispositions in Aircall.
  • Time-zone/DST rigor; calendar accuracy.
  • Proactive, friendly, enthusiastic “go-getter” with excellent phone presence.

Nice to Have

  • Demonstrated ability to disqualify low-intent leads and protect Sales time.
  • Comfort discussing paid media challenges with agencies (Google/Meta/Bing). Willingness to learn.
  • Experience booking mid-market/enterprise demos across the US/EMEA.
  • Awareness of outreach compliance and opt-out best practices

If you read this and thought “that’s me,” we’d love to hear from you.
